coverage.notes: Checked the main-campus 2026 examination, examination-exemption and Boya undergraduate prospectuses; the 2025-11-24 departmental admission catalogue; the Health Science Center 2026 international undergraduate prospectus; and specialist English-language routes. The 2026 direct-entry international undergraduate programmes covered by these notices are taught in Chinese, including Clinical Medicine and Oral Medicine at the separate Health Science Center. Guanghua Future Leaders starts at PKU in years 3-4 after two years at a partner university and is not a direct PKU first-year route. A Health Science Center 2027 undergraduate notice dated 2026-10-16 is indexed by the official website, but its linked attachment could not be retrieved: the web reader returned an older 2026 version at the same URL. No complete 2027 main-campus undergraduate prospectus or independently verified English-taught first-year degree was located. This cannot establish that 2027 options are definitively absent; the scope therefore remains undetermined. Historical 2026 rules below do not constitute 2027 entry requirements.
